ModMetaData.name: Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Fluffy
ModMetaData.description:
Forked 1.5 version of [url=steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=725219116] Fluffy Work Tab [/url] mod.
[b] The packageId of the mod has not been modified. Can maintain compatibility. [/b]
Fixed some bugs: [list] [*]Fix: Numeric settings are reset after restarting the game. 修复了重启游戏后优先级设置被重置的问题 [*]Fix: Disabled WorkGiver still draws a priority box. 修复了被禁用的工作也显示优先级单元格的问题 [*]Fix: Paste button cannot be displayed. 修复了粘贴按钮不显示的问题 [*]Fix: Biotech DLC Mechs error 修复了生物科技DLC机械体不兼容的问题 [*]Fix: draw horizontal line bug 修复了绘制水平分割线的问题 [*]Fix: paste button of the last column does not appear when the column is expanded. 修复了工作列展开时粘贴按钮的问题 [*]Check if the table's height exceeds the screen height. 修复了表格超出屏幕高度的问题 [*]Highlight the pawn's current work. 高亮小人当前的工作 [*]Add missing translations 添加缺失的翻译信息
[/list]
For more information, please refer to [url=https://github.com/JiaRG/WorkTab] GitHub [/url] submission information.
Recommended to use with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2069684319] [FSF] Complex Jobs [/url] mod.
If you encounter any problems, please try to create an issue on GitHub. Thx!
[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1] This is an updated version of an existing mod, I claim no ownership of the original code. This version may be taken down by request from the original author. The original author is free to use this mod to update their own.
